messages:
Priya (CS): FYI AegisSynth launching EU pilot in ~12h. They asked for: allowlist for a small CIDR range, temporary QPS increase for 3h, pin to eu-west-1 with failover to ap-northeast-1, and a post-launch health review. They flagged renewal as \'at-risk\' if launch throttles. Can NetOps + SRE own this?
Kai (Solutions): I can run the smoke tests and craft a minimal runbook. Need exact CIDR, account id, and the UTC window. Also confirm whether failover should be automatic or manual.
Jon (NetOps): We prefer automatic failover but with a conservative autoscale policy. For allowlist we need CIDR format; will implement as ipset. Autorevoke TTL?
Priya (CS): Account id `aegissynth-eu-02`. CIDR: `198.51.100.0/29`. IPv6 not required. Window: 2026-04-02T18:00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T21:00:00Z. QPS from 250 -> 1000. Autorevoke at +2h after window end (so 2026-04-02T23:00:00Z). Failover: automatic to `ap-northeast-1` but only if p95 latency > 2000ms OR 5xx > 2% for 2 consecutive mins.
Jon (NetOps): Copy. Opening CFG ticket and scheduling staged rollout. Will set allowlist, rate override and region pin + automated failover rule.
Jon (NetOps): deploy-bot created CFG-7889 for `aegissynth-eu-02` (allowlist + qps + region pin + failover). Rolling out canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. ETA ~20m to full.
deploy-bot: CFG-7889 scheduled 1: canary 2026-04-02T17:55Z -> gradual steps -> full. No planned downtime.
Eun (SRE): I'll add synthetics for account-level p50/p95, 5xx rate, and error traces. Rollback triggers: p95 > 2000ms OR 5xx > 2% sustained > 2m. I'll also add an alert channel to #incidents and tag on-call.
Kai (Solutions): Smoke curl for canary: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":8}'` expect 200 and p50 < 400ms. I'll run from eu-west-1.
Priya (CS): Nina (AM) wants to be on the post-launch call and will prep a renewal contingency email template for the customer if there are issues. Nina, can you join the 1-hour post-mortem slot?
Nina (AM): Yes, I'll join. I'll also draft a short credit offer (one-week complimentary burst) if we have any sustained throttling impact. Looping in finance after launch if needed.
Jon (NetOps): Canary applied: ipset add `198.51.100.0/29` on 5% traffic, rate override active on canary. Autorevoke scheduled at 2026-04-02T23:00:00Z.
Eun (SRE): Canary metrics: 200 responses, p50 220ms, p95 560ms, 5xx 0.1%. Promoting to 25%.
Jon (NetOps): 25% -> 100% rollout completed. CFG-7889 closed. Logs: ```
ALLOWLIST ADD aegissynth-eu-02 198.51.100.0/29
RATE_OVERRIDE SET aegissynth-eu-02 1000 QPS window 2026-04-02T18:00Z/2026-04-02T21:00Z AUTOREVOKE 2026-04-02T23:00:00Z
REGION_PIN SET aegissynth-eu-02 eu-west-1 FAILOVER ap-northeast-1 TRIGGERS p95>2000ms OR 5xx>2%
```
Priya (CS): Great job team. I'll post the runbook & canary results to the customer timeline and send the PM the post-launch checklist. :white_check_mark:
Kai (Solutions): Uploaded runbook and test vectors to the customer repo. Linked in the account doc.
Nina (AM): Post-launch note: schedule follow-up with AegisSynth in 48 hours to capture feedback and capture renewal sentiment. I'll draft the renewal playbook with options.
Priya (CS): Closing thread 1: rollout successful. Action item: add short NPS-style survey to capture onboarding feedback and note the credit contingency in the renewal cadence.
